code:
def three_letters():
    print("  started")
    yield "a"
    print("  resumed after a")
    yield "b"
    print("  resumed after b")

gen = three_letters()
print("nothing has run yet")
print(next(gen))
print(next(gen))
try:
    next(gen)
except StopIteration:
    print("StopIteration: the generator is used up")
